children: Enterprise AI software firm Wonderful said on Wednesday it had raised $550 million in a funding round that valued it at $5 billion.
The round, led by Insight Partners, included participation from Salesforce and existing investors Index Ventures, IVP, Vine Ventures, 9Yards and Bessemer Venture Partners.
Wonderful said the funding will be used to accelerate product development, expand its global deployment teams and meet growing demand for its AI operating system.
The company, founded in 2025, said it has expanded to more than 35 markets and grown to 650 employees since its Series B funding round in March.
